authority_meaning.contract: Part of the frozen order lifecycle contract v1. The application must satisfy it.
authority_meaning.proposed: A maintenance policy under discussion (for example the reliability benchmark's task B). NOT part of the application baseline; listed so the gap is explicit and no agent mistakes it for current behavior.
authority_meaning.unresolved: A requested behavior with undecided policy. Nothing executable may represent it; implementing it without a decision is inventing policy.

obligations.title: Unknown op is rejected before anything else
obligations.prose: Any op other than place/pay/ship/cancel/refund produces invalid_command regardless of version or state.

representations.text: orders.validation.operation(command.op) != Operation.Unknown or result.outcome == Outcome.InvalidCommand

obligations.title: Version conflict is rejected before state and field validation
obligations.prose: For a known op, expected_version unequal to the current version yields conflict even when state or fields are invalid.

representations.text: orders.validation.operation(command.op) == Operation.Unknown or command.expected_version == state.version or result.outcome == Outcome.Conflict

obligations.title: Illegal source state is rejected before business fields and stock
obligations.prose: invalid_state precedes invalid_order/out_of_stock/invalid_refund. The legal table in orders.validation.legal is the source of truth; the ordering itself is not expressible as a single postcondition without restating the table.

representations.text: Precedence among invalid_state, invalid_order and out_of_stock is covered only by the listed tests and the acceptance corpus; there is no runtime contract for the ordering.

obligations.title: Rejected commands preserve every state field
obligations.source: CONTRACT.md, Domain and transport: failures preserve every state field
obligations.prose: Any outcome other than ok leaves the state structurally identical, including version and stock.

representations.text: result.outcome == Outcome.Ok or result.state == state

obligations.title: A successful command increments the version exactly once
obligations.prose: Successful changes increment version by exactly one.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.version == state.version + 1

obligations.title: Member discount is floor(gross * 5%) and nonmembers pay gross
obligations.prose: Net = gross - floor(gross*500/10000) for members; net = gross otherwise. Membership here is the placing command's member flag; the contract keeps no membership after placement.

representations.text: not member or result.net_cents == quantity * unit_cents - quantity * unit_cents * 500 / 10000
member or result.net_cents == quantity * unit_cents

obligations.title: Tax is floor(net * 8.25%) on the discounted net
obligations.prose: Tax basis is net after discount, never gross.

representations.text: result.tax_cents == result.net_cents * 825 / 10000

obligations.title: Shipping is 500 below a 10000 net threshold, else 0
obligations.prose: Shipping = 0 if net >= 10000 else 500.

representations.text: result.net_cents < 10000 or result.shipping_cents == 0
result.net_cents >= 10000 or result.shipping_cents == 500

obligations.title: Placement reserves the quantity immediately and charges nothing
obligations.prose: Stock decreases by quantity at placement; charged and refunded amounts remain 0.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.stock == state.stock - command.quantity and result.state.quantity == command.quantity
result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.charged_cents == 0 and result.state.refunded_cents == 0 and result.state.refunded_quantity == 0

obligations.title: Quoted amounts and quantity are fixed at placement and preserved by every later transition
obligations.prose: net_cents, tax_cents, shipping_cents and quantity are written only by placement and copied unchanged by pay, ship, cancel and refund.

obligations.title: Payment charges net + tax + shipping from the saved quote
obligations.prose: The charge is the saved quote, not a recomputation from the pay command.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.charged_cents == state.net_cents + state.tax_cents + state.shipping_cents

obligations.title: Cancellation returns the entire quantity to stock
obligations.prose: Reserved or paid orders may be cancelled; the whole quantity is restocked.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.stock == state.stock + state.quantity

obligations.title: Paid cancellation refunds the whole charge including shipping; reserved cancellation refunds nothing
obligations.prose: This is the only path on which shipping is refunded under contract v1.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or state.status != Status.Paid or result.state.refunded_cents == state.charged_cents and result.state.refunded_quantity == state.quantity
result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or state.status != Status.Reserved or result.state.refunded_cents == 0 and result.state.refunded_quantity == 0

obligations.title: Cumulative refund is floor((net+tax) * cumulative_quantity / original_quantity); shipping is never refunded by refund
obligations.prose: Entitlement is computed cumulatively so that splitting refunds never changes the total; shipping is excluded from every refund operation.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.refunded_cents == (state.net_cents + state.tax_cents) * result.state.refunded_quantity / state.quantity

obligations.title: Refund quantity is 1..remaining and accumulates
obligations.prose: Quantity outside 1..(quantity - refunded_quantity) is invalid_refund; otherwise refunded_quantity grows by exactly that amount and never exceeds the original quantity.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.refunded_quantity == state.refunded_quantity + quantity and result.state.refunded_quantity <= state.quantity

obligations.title: Cumulative refunds never exceed the amount charged
obligations.prose: Across every transition, refunded_cents <= charged_cents. Derived from the refund formula and the paid-cancel rule; it is an invariant, not a separately stated sentence of the contract.

representations.text: result.state.refunded_cents <= result.state.charged_cents

obligations.title: Refund returns exactly the newly refunded quantity to stock
obligations.prose: Stock increases by the refunded quantity of this command only.

representations.text: result.outcome != Outcome.Ok or result.state.stock == state.stock + quantity

obligations.title: Cancelled and refunded are terminal
obligations.prose: No known op is legal from cancelled or refunded; the legal table returns false for both.

representations.text: The transition table is exhaustive by construction (match over Status); no separate runtime contract restates it.

obligations.title: Membership eligibility is fixed at order placement
obligations.source: benchmarks/agent_reliability/CONTRACT.md, task B (maintenance request, not contract v1)
obligations.prose: Under the proposed return policy, membership is determined by the placing command and later command.member values must not change eligibility. Contract v1 keeps no membership after placement: State has no member field, so this cannot be represented in the baseline.

representations.text: Not representable in the baseline: requires a retained membership field in State. See benchmarks/obligations/subjects/orders_policy_b for the executable form.

obligations.title: Partial returns refund merchandise plus tax only
obligations.prose: Until the entire shipped order has been returned, refunds exclude shipping. Coincides with contract v1 for every refund; listed separately because the proposed policy changes the full-return case.

representations.text: Baseline behavior already excludes shipping on every refund (ORD-REF-001). The proposed policy only differs at full return.

obligations.title: A member's complete return refunds the original shipping exactly once
obligations.prose: When the entire shipped order has been returned by a member (membership from placement), the original shipping charge is added to the cumulative refund once. Nonmembers never receive shipping through returns. Paid cancellation is unchanged.

representations.text: Contradicts contract v1 ORD-REF-001 for members at full return. Adopting it requires a contract amendment; it is not silently applied to this application.

obligations.title: Courtesy returns after a full refund for loyal customers
obligations.prose: Eligibility (what is a loyal customer), benefit, limits, inventory effect and interaction with prior refunds are unspecified. No executable representation is permitted until the policy is decided.

representations.text: Open questions: eligibility criterion, benefit amount, per-order or per-customer limit, stock effect, interaction with refunded_cents <= charged_cents (ORD-REF-003).
